notes.title: Tom's Quest: Storyteller's Festival Developer Stream!
notes.content:
You know him, you love him, you got traumatized by his bad ending: Join the developers of Band Camp Boyfriend here on our Steam page on Monday, February 17th & Wednesday, February 19th at 7pm EST to play Tom's route! 

Make in-game choices to determine Tom's fate, ask questions during the livestream, or just simply hang out. Both streams will be held during The Storyteller's Festival, a celebration of games with a strong narrative, so be sure to check out everything the festival has to offer!

Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Band Camp Boyfriend's Original Soundtrack - Now Available!
notes.content:
Strike up the band because Band Camp Boyfriend's Original Soundtrack is now available for purchase! Enjoy the unforgettable music of Camp Bearpaw, composed by the talented Alexandra Burton. From Tom's carefree trombone in "Let It Slide," to the romantic yet sorrowful piano of "Swan Song;" from the proud Blue Mountain Alma Mater to that final performance of Gustav Holst's Jupiter--relive the story of Band Camp Boyfriend through the music.

Band Camp Boyfriend's soundtrack features compositions by Gustav Holst, Edvard Grieg, John Philip Sousa, Camille Saint-Saëns, Léo Delibes, and the Hill Sisters.

Available Formats:
MP3 - 16 bit
WAV - 16 bit

notes.title: Nominate Band Camp Boyfriend for "Outstanding Story-Rich Game!"
notes.content:
Nominate Band Camp Boyfriend for Steam Awards 2023 in the category of Outstanding Story-Rich Game!!

Do we have a snowball's chance in hell? NOPE! But that doesn't mean we still can't show up to hell! 

Nominations are open! Why not take a minute out of your day to show a little love for the marching band that stole your heart?

Thank you so much in advance! We sincerely appreciate you!

notes.title: 11/12 Update for Band Camp Boyfriend
notes.content:
It's hard to believe Band Camp Boyfriend has been out for half a year! Today, I've updated the game with these fixes...

-Added a missing bad ending to the ending list.
-Fixed a bug where Poptart's fourth CG was only unlocking through playing the bad ending.
-Added a couple voice lines for Tom and Peter that got lost in the mix during production.
-Fixed some new issues that were popping up with the font.
-Changed Flora's name to "Lite" in the opening/credits.
-Fixed a couple other minor typos/errors.

Fingers crossed everything is in order. 

Remember, if the game crashes for any reason, please try verifying the integrity of the files to see if that fixes it! We've had a couple reports of the game crashing on a random CG, but it turns out it was Steam-related and thankfully an easy fix. Here's how to do so: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/0C48-FCBD-DA71-93EB

As always, thanks so much for playing Band Camp Boyfriend! Hope you all have an enjoyable holiday season. Don't forget to follow Lovebird Game Studios on social media for future updates--we hope to release some BCB-related goodies in the future! :)

-Taylor

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Band Camp Boyfriend will release in its entirety on May 11, 2023.

I expect to see every single one of you on that field, fully hydrated and ready to work hard! We’ve got a show to learn!

notes.title: Storyteller's Festival - Developer Stream
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that Band Camp Boyfriend has been selected to be featured in the first ever Storyteller’s Festival, hosted by Two and a Half Studios! 

From March 25th to April 1st, they’ll be showing off the cream of the crop in visual novels and indie games with a strong narrative. Check out upcoming games or score a deal during the sale!

We will be re-airing our stream from Steam Next Fest during the event, so if you missed it, here’s your chance to catch it again! Catch the re-air at 6pm EST on March 26th.

notes.title: Let's Find Love at Band Camp! ~ Next Fest Developer Livestream 2/9
notes.content:
Join the developers of Band Camp Boyfriend on Monday 2/6 and Thursday 2/9 at 8pm EST as we play our upcoming otome visual novel game! Will we find love while surviving band camp? That's up to you! Guide our path by making choices in the chat. Enjoy our bad jokes, attempts at voice acting, insights into the game, and never-before-seen content! Feel free to ask questions along the way. 

Monday stream will include...

-Developer introductions
-Backstory on the game
-Play-through of in-game Days 1-2

Thursday stream will include...

-Play-through of in-game Days 3-4
-Unseen content (we will go beyond where the demo concludes to the end of Day 4)!
-Final thoughts on release

See you at band camp!
